summary: This guide covers every top-performing team composition for Phase 2 of the Season 8 Endboss, Mekkatorque, on the China server. Phase 2 scales Mekkatorque to level 280 with 2.27 billion HP, higher accuracy/resistance checks, uncleansable defense down debuffs, and buff immunity windows. Toxin dominates the top spot hitting up to 2.4B damage, followed by Radiance, Shadow, and Frost (which surprisingly outperforms its Phase 1 damage). Fire suffers the heaviest damage drop and is not recommended for Phase 2 investment.

meta_changes: Mekkatorque Phase 2 Boss scales to Level 280 with 2.27B HP and 336 Acc/Res.
Boss applies uncleansable Tier 2 Defense Down, skill bar pushback, and 50% Defense self-buff.
Frost team performance improves in Phase 2 compared to Phase 1 due to buff stripping mechanics.
Fire Burn teams suffer a major damage drop (down to 500M-600M) and are not recommended.
tips: Add about 30 Accuracy to all damage dealers over Phase 1 builds.
Stack 300+ Resistance on timing-control and dispeller heroes so their skill rotations do not drift.
Ensure disrupters/dispellers like Vinyara or Anneliesis strip the boss's 50% Defense buff promptly.
Maintain over 25 Haste on Thunderbolt heroes like Perkunte and Alora to prevent damage falloff.
